purpose: Decide whether GraphRAG (LightRAG) earns further investment by measuring, on multi-hop questions over a pooled corpus with distractors, whether it retrieves better evidence and yields better answers than the existing hybrid retrieval, at what cost.

production_fidelity.answer_context: Production knowledge answers see retrieved text chunks only; LightRAG entities and relationships are not passed to the model (services/knowledge_agent.py). The primary comparison therefore gives both methods chunks only.
production_fidelity.lightrag_query: graph_service.engine.LightRAGEngine.query as in production: aquery_data mode=mix, top_k=40, chunk_top_k=20, rerank disabled.
production_fidelity.lightrag_index: graph_service.engine.LightRAGEngine with Settings.from_env (the KNOWLEDGE_* production configuration); only the database, directories and llm_max_async differ.
production_fidelity.baseline: services.vectorstore.deal_document + hybrid_query_document: BM25 + dense + RRF, rerank disabled (RERANKER_ENABLED=false in production).
production_fidelity.embedding: Both methods use the knowledge embedding model (BAAI/bge-m3). The main app's configured bge-large-zh-v1.5 is Chinese-only and would handicap the baseline on English text; the deviation is recorded, not hidden.
production_fidelity.dependency_isolation: Each method runs in the environment it runs in production (main app vs knowledge service); they pin different openai versions.

corpus.unit: One MuSiQue paragraph (title + text) is one baseline chunk and one LightRAG document.
corpus.pooling: All 20 paragraphs of every sampled question, deduplicated, form one knowledge base.

methods.lightrag_naive: Diagnostic: LightRAG's vector-only retrieval over the same index, separating the graph's contribution from differences in chunk storage and embedding calls.
methods.lightrag_mix_with_graph_facts: Diagnostic answer arm: the mix chunks plus the entity and relationship descriptions LightRAG returned, showing what production leaves unused.

retrieval_metrics.ranked_list: Source IDs deduplicated in first-retrieved order.
retrieval_metrics.recall_at_k: Supporting source IDs in the top k divided by supporting source IDs, k in {5, 10, 20}.
retrieval_metrics.full_support_at_k: 1 if every supporting source ID is in the top k, else 0.
retrieval_metrics.latency: Wall-clock per query, p50 and p95.

answering.model: The production knowledge answer profile: KNOWLEDGE_QA_MODEL (falling back to KNOWLEDGE_LLM_MODEL) on the knowledge provider, thinking as KNOWLEDGE_QA_ENABLE_THINKING. Temperature 0 instead of the configured production value, for repeatability. One call per question and arm, no retries; a failed call scores 0 and is reported.
answering.prompt: System: Answer the question using only the passages. Reply with JSON {"answer": "<shortest phrase that answers the question>"}. If the passages do not contain the answer, reply {"answer": "unknown"}. User: numbered passages (title and text), then the question.
answering.metrics: SQuAD normalisation (lowercase, strip punctuation and articles, collapse whitespace); exact match and token F1 against the answer and its aliases, taking the maximum.

statistics.paired_bootstrap: 10000 resamples of questions, seed 20260925; 95% percentile interval of the mean difference.
statistics.binary_outcomes: Exact McNemar test for exact match and full_support@10.
statistics.breakdown: Every metric is also reported per hop group (2hop, 3hop, 4hop); groups are descriptive, not separately tested.

decision_rule.primary_endpoint: Answer token F1, lightrag_mix minus hybrid_rrf.
decision_rule.invest: Mean difference >= +5 F1 points AND the 95% interval's lower bound > 0.
decision_rule.shrink: The 95% interval's upper bound < +2 F1 points: no practically relevant benefit is plausible. GraphRAG stays optional and off by default; no further investment in its concurrency, pooling or scale work.
decision_rule.inconclusive: Anything else. Report the retrieval endpoints (full_support@10, recall@10) and cost, and decide with them rather than rerunning until a threshold is met.
decision_rule.cost_is_reported_not_gated: Index token usage, index wall time and query latency are reported beside the outcome; they inform how much to invest, not the category.

cost_accounting.index_tokens: LightRAG extraction calls report provider usage through the SDK token tracker; a call without usage is counted as unknown, not zero.
cost_accounting.currency: Not estimated; the provider bill is the authority.

not_measured: Chinese material (the product's real language); this is an English benchmark.
Production Autonomous multi-round tool use; answering is one shared single call.
Global or thematic questions, where GraphRAG claims a different advantage.
